channels.name: Obsidian community themes
channels.instructions: Submit living-code-theme/obsidian as the source repository, not this ZIP as a plugin. Review root manifest.json, theme.css, README, LICENSE and screenshot.png. Commit the reviewed files and create a release whose tag exactly matches manifest.version, without a v prefix, attaching manifest.json and theme.css. Follow the current community theme submission procedure. No release or tag is created by packaging.
